Retain volumeMl only for explicitly stated ml; no unit conversion. For multiple size choices keep the original regular/standard-then-smallest-adult selection; indistinguishable ordering uses first in document reading order. Identify branches explicitly associated with this menu in the assigned district. Copy its whole displayed name without appending city/brand text. addressText is the first complete contiguous street/postal address block for that selected branch, excluding phone/hours; join line breaks as spaces, never reconstruct an address from scattered fragments. Multiple unresolved branch associations mean geography unknown; absent usable name/address means null. operatorName is the first explicitly identified legal operator name for this branch, copied literally, else null; a copyright owner alone does not establish operator. menuGroup is a literal named common-menu/brand identity ONLY where source explicitly says the same menu applies to multiple branches/venues, else null; generic "drinks/menu" headings are not group IDs. No translation or inferred corporate relationship. All identical source strings will undergo only NFC/lowercase/trim/whitespace normalization; genuine source differences remain disputes.
